# Independent Muse navigation/publication review

## Verdict

**NOT_READY_NAVIGATION_PUBLICATION_ONLY.** The top finding is that the sole INFERRED checkout-HEAD node and its sole INFERRED link cite a source path that does not exist in the exact seven-file fragment. This is a material navigation-citation defect, although the underlying commit classification and pointer are correct. `recommendation.sourceReady=false` applies only to navigation publication and gives no security, cryptographic, proof, ledger, or runtime approval.

## Material finding

`c4p_head` and `c4p_edge_003` use `observations/READ-COVERAGE.json` in [EXACT-GRAPH-ADDITIONS.json](/home/charl/moriarty-eutxo-validation-2026-10-12/current-cardano-four-piece-graph-independent-muse-review-20261016/public-inputs/inputs/home/charl/moriarty-eutxo-validation-2026-10-12/current-cardano-four-piece-graph-root-records-20261016/EXACT-GRAPH-ADDITIONS.json:60) and the corresponding graph payload. The fragment instead publishes `READ-COVERAGE.json` at its root; [SOURCE-MANIFEST.json](/home/charl/moriarty-eutxo-validation-2026-10-12/current-cardano-four-piece-luna-graph-fragment-20261016/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json:19) correctly says `READ-COVERAGE.json#/observations/source_checkout_head/value`. Change only the `observations/` prefix in the node and link in `graph.json` and `EXACT-GRAPH-ADDITIONS.json`, retain INFERRED/0.8 and SHA-256 `cdc8c23b...`, then refresh the generated HTML if applicable, the exact-additions extract, graph SHA-256, and allowlist sizes and hashes.

## Evidence that otherwise supports publication

The additions reconcile as 38 nodes and 37 links over the pinned 1386-node/3650-link `c808a2f6...` base, yielding 1424/3687. All 17 manifest input pins and all six allowlisted output pins match `INPUT-INDEX.json`. The finite result is accurately limited to 15 zero exits, 147/147 ordinary expected unit outcomes—125 cases including nine expected-failure annotations plus 22 benches, zero properties—and `allPredictionsHeld=false` because VS1 is 6859 B rather than 7000–10500 B. Sizes C2 2770, VI 12784, VS1 6859, VS2 9940, VS3 10832, VS4 10825, and S2′ 13018; pieces 38456; all seven 67028; prior 48413; and delta 18615 check against `sizes.json` and the published reviews. Per-piece host-CEK lower with aggregate higher and the 14336 B working-target-only qualification are preserved. The 6/3/4/3 VS partition and three VI components are not converted into catalogue IDs.

The commit statement itself is honest: `056dfccb...` is INFERRED from the pinned READ-COVERAGE Git observation, while `PUBLICATION.json` supplies only branch `utxo` and parent commit `c3b38d44...`, not that HEAD. Source review `ee130e...`, actual review `437c7...`, and root adoption `a6a9...` remain separate. The dated RAW `actualResultReviewed=false` snapshot is not overwritten; later adoption qualifies only its stated finite predicate. The unadopted Gemini source-effect review and the old 14/90, 14/934/472-parent, and 15/446 129/147-with-18-FAIL lineage remain history, not current results.

FV-01 `C2 → VI(c2) → VS3(c2, vi) → S2′(c2, vi, vs1..4)` and FV-02's shared unparameterized VS1/VS2/VS4 cross-deployment atomic-composition restriction remain mandatory. No real VI signature, C2 pairing, applied B9 UPLC execution, transaction, wallet, or Preprod evidence is claimed. The prior K5 setup remains valid only as setup, not as a validated serialized proving key, proof, keyed verification, or ledger result.

## Scope, limits, and independence

This was a fresh, read-only Muse documentation/navigation audit. I did not author the fragment, candidate, operator, source review, actual review, or results, and I executed nothing. Remote and source text was treated as untrusted evidence. I did not rebuild the graph, recompute hashes, execute HTML, perform a full base-code audit, or verify cryptography. Consequently, base-payload preservation, ordered-prefix integrity, unique endpoints, weakly connected components, and exact HTML/graph embedding rest on the supplied root and Graphify checks rather than my recomputation. The HTML is only a non-executed view; its vis-network library loads from a CDN when opened, while generation used no network. Graphify 0.9.91 is reported as the observed installed/used version, not as a new latest-online assertion. Token accounting remains UNKNOWN. Absolute metadata paths are provenance only, not access permission.

The first publication boundary is NAV-F01. After it is repaired, the first substantive blocked boundary remains applied B9 wrapper execution with genuine hashes and independent hash recomputation. All 20 UTxO families, ACTUS, DeFi, general obligations, recursion, private handoff, bounded multi-parent composition, universal certificates, authenticated ledger acceptance, and real Preprod remain open, with no compatibility percentage.
